lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, showing a regular grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with primary circular blobs, creating a rectilinear network of anchor nodes particularly visible in the posterior two-thirds of the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Internal surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-18 discrete high-luminance blobs, distributed with higher density near the anterior leading edge than the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned ventral to the pectoral fin and along the lower-mid flank region.
